summary: Backend (external NekSathi API) + Expo web frontend tested end-to-end using demo@neksathi.app / demo1234. 13/13 backend endpoints (auth, SOS, contacts, safe zones, family, vehicles, tags, cards, devices intruder/sim-swap, alerts, incidents, live-share, update-me) return 200/201 and persist. Frontend: login lands on Home with sos-button; stat cards, live share, alerts button all visible; navigation to Contacts, Family (already-joined view with invite-chip), Security (both Anti-theft & Smart QR segments with chip row and add buttons), Profile (edit / prefs / logout) all work; logout returns to Login; Register screen loads. No red-screen errors and no functional bugs found. Deprecated packages detected: none. Minor RN-Web deprecation console warnings only (shadow* props, pointerEvents prop, React 19 ref).

issues: Header title 'Hi, Demo' truncated behind the top-right 'Welcome back!' toast on 390px width during first render; toast overlays the header (see /tmp/03_home.png). Consider offsetting toast below header or shortening initial greeting.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web deprecation: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — use 'boxShadow' (repeated warnings on app load). Likely from GlassCard/NeonButton shadow styling.
React-Native-Web deprecation: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents. Emitted after login navigation (likely from a third-party like @gorhom/bottom-sheet or reanimated).
Console error: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' Fires when Family tab mounts — probably from @gorhom/bottom-sheet or react-native-maps web fallback.

action_items: (Optional) Replace 'shadow*' RN style props with 'boxShadow' in components (GlassCard, NeonButton, SOSButton) to silence RN-Web warnings.
(Optional) Audit callers of the legacy pointerEvents prop and move to style.pointerEvents.
(Optional) Reposition toast so it does not overlap the top-right bell icon and username on very narrow widths.
No functional fixes required — all critical flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth guard in AuthContext.tsx correctly routes based on segments and 401 interceptor clears secure-store token — good.
All API calls funnel through the axios interceptor which attaches the JWT from expo-secure-store; base URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL — no hardcoding.
All interactive elements have testID attributes; text nodes are wrapped in <Text>.
Family map has a web fallback image (native-only real map) — expected per problem statement.
seed_data_creation: Created (and left) TEST_-prefixed emergency-contact, safe-zone, vehicle, tag, card, device on the shared demo account. Contacts/safe-zones were deleted after assertion; QR items and device intentionally remain (endpoint has no DELETE in the app).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is EXTERNAL at EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://neksathi-deploy.preview.emergentagent.com (not built here). Frontend served at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Use demo@neksathi.app / demo1234 (also via 'Use demo account' testID=fill-demo-button on Login). Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_neksathi_api.py for API regression. Because the demo account is shared globally, family/QR data persists between runs (Family tab already shows an in-family state with invite-chip). Web SOS tap will fail geolocation silently unless browser permission is granted — that's expected; native build required.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs to RCA. All requested phase 1-7 flows verified via UI + underlying API.
